subject.title: fix(slack): preserve files on mentioned room messages

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `message` as the canonical room-mention source through this new persisted Slack setting, including the generated-manifest and upgrade guidance?
rationale: The code can preserve the old `auto` behavior, but selecting the long-term default and supported Slack subscription contract is a user-facing compatibility decision for existing Slack installations.

options.title: Accept the explicit compatibility setting
options.body: Keep `auto` for existing app-mention-only installations, document the opt-in `message` path for dual-subscribed apps, and require staging proof before merge.

options.title: Prefer a routing-only fix
options.body: Ask for a solution that coalesces duplicate envelopes without exposing a new Slack configuration setting if the existing event contract can support it.

options.title: Pause for Slack owner direction
options.body: Defer the PR until a Slack-area owner confirms the supported subscription and upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the explicit compatibility setting
recommendation.body: Keep `auto` for existing app-mention-only installations, document the opt-in `message` path for dual-subscribed apps, and require staging proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: sjf is the available recent contributor with direct evidence across the changed Slack setup, runtime, and test surfaces; historical ownership evidence could not be completed in the restricted read-only shell.
